summary: MISBAR – Forgotten Space Relics Explorer is an interactive educational website that takes visitors through three historical eras to explore six spacecraft missions across the Moon, Mars, and Jupiter. It combines mission facts, stories, images, and quizzes in a space-themed experience, with a customizable astronaut and visual effects that make learning about space exploration more engaging.
details:
Our project is an interactive educational website that explores spacecraft left in space or on other worlds after completing their missions. Visitors can discover these spacecraft, learn about their journeys, and understand their scientific achievements through clear descriptions, images, animations, and educational games.

The project makes space exploration easier to understand, especially for students and people without a scientific background. By bringing mission information into an engaging experience, we aim to preserve the stories of these spacecraft, encourage curiosity, and inspire visitors to learn more about science and technology.

We developed the website using React, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. We used NASA mission information as the foundation for our educational content. The website runs in a browser and does not require specialized hardware.

Our creative approach combines a space-themed visual experience with storytelling and interactive learning. Instead of presenting mission facts alone, we help visitors explore the spacecraft as part of a journey and connect their discoveries with puzzles and exploration.

During development, our team considered scientific accuracy, simple language, mobile compatibility, easy navigation, and loading performance. Since our website includes many images and animations, balancing visual quality with a smooth experience was an important consideration. As a team of five beginner developers, we also considered how to divide tasks and keep the project achievable with our skills and available time.
